responsibility: Make the production MATLAB trees visible and check installation requirements.
contracts: reset restores MATLAB's default path first; add preserves existing entries. Both prepend etc, experiments, interfaces and kernel recursively. Neither adds examples or tests.
change_guidance: For missing or shadowed functions, inspect MATLAB path resolution before changing numerical code. Examples that read sibling data via relative paths expect the example directory as the working directory.

responsibility: Separate audited physical constants from numerical lookup and from the model that uses them.
contracts: The offline builder prepares the typed MAT payload. Physical isotope lookup returns signed angular magnetogyric ratio and multiplicity; missing properties are not zero. Table metadata do not automatically apply abundance weights or radioactive decay.
change_guidance: Change the sourced table and rebuild its payload together. Clear spin in each process used to test the new data: numerical lookup caches the table in persistent storage.

responsibility: Translate external scientific data into model inputs without tying the spin kernel to a file format.
contracts: Gaussian and ORCA readers produce property records; g2spinach selects atoms by element and maps their parsed isotopes, tensors, and element-specific references into sys and inter. GISSMO builds those inputs directly from a selected XML coupling matrix.
change_guidance: Change format-specific parsing in the reader and shared physical conversions in the mapper. Check the imported isotope and both halves of the stored coupling tensor, not just parsed text. Check signed isotope scaling in isoswap after substitution.

responsibility: Turn acquired samples into displayed or exchangeable data without redefining the simulated experiment.
contracts: The COSY example windows and Fourier-transforms the FID before selecting the real component for display. A JCAMP adapter takes the supplied signal and explicit domains; it does not perform that processing.
For jcamp_nmr the 2D signal array is [F2,F1], while domains are specified in physical [F1,F2] order. Preserve complex components and sampling coordinates across the format boundary.
change_guidance: Change spectral axes in the shared axis routines when the convention is common to plotting and export; change JCAMP encoding in the writer. Validate axes with asymmetric dimensions and offsets.

responsibility: Build and call selected native accelerators alongside MATLAB implementations and callers.
contracts: The build targets include line-shape convolution, cubic roots and sparse indexing as well as a separate sparse GPU multiply. Each binary is written beside its source.
change_guidance: Distinguish testing the MATLAB dispatch/fallback from testing the compiled operation against CPU products. A skipped GPU check is not a numerical pass.

responsibility: Discover registered physical and numerical checks and run a targeted selection.
contracts: run_test requires one match by ID or name; run_tests can filter multiple entries. Individual test headers declare their IDs and names; manual-only tests are not scheduled.
change_guidance: Register new regressions beside tests for the affected boundary. Use a physical invariant or an independent reference; an example reproduces a workflow but is not automatically a registered test.
